name: Several plausible root causes
description: Empty username passed to normalize_username raises IndexError. Fix could be in caller or callee, but callee is shared across services and directly matches the exception frame.
expected_behavior: normalize_username guards against empty string and returns empty string.
golden_patch:
--- a/auth_utils.py
+++ b/auth_utils.py
@@ -1,4 +1,6 @@
 def normalize_username(name: str | None) -> str:
     # BUG: unconditionally indexes name[0] without checking if string is empty
+    if not name:
+        return ""
     return name[0].lower() + name[1:]

candidate_hypotheses.root_cause_statement: normalize_username lacks empty/None guard before string indexing.
supporting_evidence: IndexError: string index out of range in auth_utils.py line 3
candidate_hypotheses.observed_behavior: Raised IndexError: string index out of range
candidate_hypotheses.expected_behavior: Return empty string when input is empty
candidate_hypotheses.causal_explanation: Direct indexing of name[0] when len(name) == 0 raises IndexError.
candidate_hypotheses.proposed_repair_strategy: Add if not name: return '' guard to normalize_username in auth_utils.py

candidate_hypotheses.root_cause_statement: login_user in auth_service should reject empty username prior to calling normalization.
missing_evidence_or_assumptions: Does not fix register_user or other callers; does not match exception frame.
